# raw path: # The sha is the RAW sha of the stored file and serves two checks: TAMPERED (our copy against
# this value) and CHANGED (the source against it). Neither is ever relaxed. A row whose bytes
# moved while its VISIBLE TEXT did not is reported `noise` and does not fail the run -- see the
# measurement in watch.py. That verdict is derived, not declared here, so no row needs an
# annotation to earn it and a newly-noisy page gets it without an edit.
